mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 2.0% triggers a preemptive S&P 500 forward return anticipation as market expects rate hikes soon, over a 20-day horizon.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 2.0% in a month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero during inflation spikes (p > 0.05), or CPIAUCSL does not exceed 2.0% in any month.

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment momentum as measured by PAYEMS exceeds 150,000 monthly increases, signaling labor market strength that supports equity valuations and drives positive 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: Over 60-day horizon, SPX 20-day forward returns are negative despite PAYEMS > 150,000 in all observed windows.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive decline in industrial production (INDPRO) of at least 2% in a month indicates weakening supply-side demand, which precedes a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as investors anticipate softening economic activity.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls by ≥2% in a month
failure_condition: No significant negative 20-day forward returns accompany INDPRO declines of ≥2% (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the monthly RSAFS below 400 million dollars for two consecutive months suggests reduced corporate credit availability, which depresses equity risk premia and yields negative 20-day forward S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: RSAFS remains above 400 for all months in the observation window, with SPX 20d returns remaining non-negative.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in FEDFUNDS above 4.0% for three consecutive months indicates persistent monetary tightening, which is associated with negative 5-day forward returns as investors anticipate slower growth.
failure_condition: No negative 5-day forward returns occur during FEDFUNDS > 4.0 for 3 months (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE below 4.0% coincides with a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as lower expected labor costs reduce wage growth expectations and boost equities.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 4.0% in a month
failure_condition: No significant positive 60-day forward returns when UNRATE < 4.0% (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of GDP-like demand momentum from GDPC1 exceeding 19,000 billion chained USD, followed by a 20-day positive S&P 500 forward return, reflects strong consumer and business demand.
failure_condition: No positive 20-day forward returns when GDPC1 > 19,000 for 2 months (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between falling HOUST (industrial output) and rising CPIAUCSL (inflation) creates a supply shock narrative, predicting negative 20-day SPX returns when both conditions coexist.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < baseline and CPIAUCSL > 2.0% in same month
failure_condition: No significant negative 20-day forward returns when both HOUST declines and CPIAUCSL > 2.0% in the same month (p > 0.05).
